verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a GPU accelerator. It has no end-user UI whose features an API could mirror, so UI/API parity is a category error for this hardware product. Its management and compute surfaces (ROCm, HIP, AMD SMI, the Kubernetes operators) are programmatic or command-line tools, not a UI. The evidence shows no first-party graphical interface that would make the parity question applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
